attchmntText: Plaza Wires Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Plaza Wires Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Total assets stood at 1,846.03 million INR as of September 30, 2026, compared to 1,827.16 million INR as of March 31, 2025. Total equity was 1,388.08 million INR. Revenue from operations for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 2,679.14 million INR. Profit before tax for the same period was 153.36 million INR. Basic earnings per share was 1.67 INR. The company noted an appeal filed against GST authorities regarding a demand of 11.51 crore INR, expecting a favorable outcome. The independent auditor issued a limited review report with no modifications.
